item.title: Trump's judges in their 30s outnumber Biden's and Obama's
item.description: President Donald Trump has appointed 31 federal judges in their 30s across his two terms, with at least two more nominees pending.

item.title: Poll: Latinos favor Democrats 59%-35% for Congress
item.description: Latino voters, a group among whom President Donald Trump made gains in 2024, now favor Democrats over Republicans 59% to 35% for control of Congress.
